inputs.prompt:
DELIVERABLE: One waist-up-to-upper-thigh character sprite for the opening scene of a Japanese romantic visual novel. Scene-specific expression and pose: the whale woman has just caught the protagonist touching her tail, and says "Human. You just touched the tip of my tail." She is annoyed, proud, embarrassed and defensive, not cheerful. Draw a single clearly adult woman aged 25, with mature facial structure and adult proportions. Medium shot, NOT a full-body illustration.

REFERENCE ROLES AND PRIORITY: Picture 1 is the PRIMARY reference for art style, eye rendering, blue hair highlights, ahoge, fin-shaped ears, blue bow clips, and ocean color palette. Picture 2 is SECONDARY: use only its deeper navy-purple hair shadows and the recognizable face identity. Do not average their costumes or camera angles. Neither reference supplies the final pose. Remove the environment, water droplets, wet clothing, swimsuit, sunglasses, maid headdress and popsicle. Preserve recognizable character identity while applying the exact outfit and pose described below.

ART DIRECTION, STRICT: Polished 2D anime visual-novel key art, close to the luminous fine-detail drawing of Picture 1. Delicate, crisp, tapered blue-gray linework, not thick black cartoon outlines. Lines slightly thicker on outer silhouette and much finer inside hair and face. Layered cel shading with two or three clearly controlled shadow levels, softened transitions only on cheeks and large hair volumes. Cool lavender ambient shadows and restrained pale cyan reflected light. Fine reflective hair ribbons, many clean separated locks, a few tiny restrained star-like hair glints; no glitter particles floating outside the silhouette. Hair highlights form coherent broad blue shapes with thin white accents, never a plastic 3D shine. Skin uses warm ivory, subtle pink cheeks, soft nose and lower-lip shading, no visible pores. Eyes are narrow almond-shaped blue eyes with dark upper lashes, layered sapphire-to-icy-blue iris gradients, precise small white catchlights and detailed pupils. Eye width and head proportions should look like an adult anime woman, not chibi or a child. Keep the shading painterly only within controlled shapes: no rough brush texture, no watercolor wash, no photorealism, no 3D/PBR rendering, no Western comic style, no flat vector illustration. Do not replace this detailed style with a generic low-detail anime sprite.

IDENTITY LOCK: Blue-black/navy hair roots, cobalt-blue midtone strands and pale icy-blue tips; long hair flows down past her hips, but lower strands may leave the bottom crop. Straight layered bangs with small gaps over the forehead. One curved loop-like ahoge entirely visible above the head. One small sky-blue bow clip on each side beside fin-shaped ears. Ear fins have dark blue upper edges and pale white-blue scalloped lower edges. Blue eyes, lightly flushed cheeks, small nose. No human animal ears, horns or extra head ornaments.

EXPRESSION: Brows pulled down toward the nose, eyes slightly narrowed and directed straight at the player, cheeks lightly pink with indignation, lips closed and pressed into a small displeased line, chin slightly raised. She should look as if she is waiting for an explanation. No smile, no seductive half-smile, no laughing face, no tears, no extreme shouting mouth. The tension should be readable immediately at dialogue-box scale.

POSE AND ANATOMY: Both hands firmly resting on her own hips, thumbs pointing backward, fingers lying naturally over the skirt waistband; BOTH elbows angle outward. Two shoulders, two arms, two hands, five fingers on each hand. Upright torso turned only 10 degrees, face toward camera. Camera at eye level, no top-down angle, no low-angle chest emphasis. Complete normal human torso and human pelvis, with two separate human thighs just visible at the bottom edge. A SINGLE additional whale tail emerges from BEHIND her lower back, curves to the viewer's right and upward so a recognizable two-lobed whale fluke appears beside her right upper arm. Tail is separate from the human body, NOT a mermaid lower half. Tail top navy blue, underside white-blue, smooth cetacean skin, small central notch in the two broad flukes. Keep a visible background gap between tail fluke and elbow. No tail in front of the torso, no duplicated tail.

COSTUME LOCK: Dry opaque white short-sleeved sailor blouse, navy sailor collar with thin pale-blue edging, one sky-blue ribbon tied at the center below the collar, fitted but not skin-tight. Fully covered chest and abdomen, no cleavage cutout, no exposed midriff. High-waisted navy pleated skirt, waistband visible beneath both hands. The bottom crop cuts through the upper thighs below the skirt hem. Natural fold directions around elbows, waist and ribbon, crisp fabric, no wet transparency or random accessories.

COMPOSITION LOCK: Portrait-format image. Medium character shot showing entire ahoge, head, shoulders, both elbows, hands, waist, skirt and only the beginning of both thighs. Head occupies roughly one quarter of image height. Top margin 5 percent, both elbows and tail fluke remain inside the left and right edges with at least 5 percent margin. No knees, calves, shoes or distant full-body framing. Center face slightly left of image center to make space for tail on right. One character, one pose, no expression sheet or inset. Bottom crop is intentional; all other silhouette edges are fully visible.

LIGHTING AND OUTPUT: Gentle summer daylight from upper left, neutral exposure, readable face, subdued cool fill on the right, restrained highlights. Uniform solid light gray background, no floor, cast shadow, beach, water, rocks, scenery or props. No text, labels, logo, watermark, UI or framing border. This is a clean standalone game sprite draft, not a scenic illustration.
